caption: The black and white line drawing depicts a cast iron gate in front of a building. The gate consists of two hinged sections, each with ornate decorative patterns featuring geometric shapes and radial motifs, as well as vertical bars ending in pointed finials. The gates are connected to a large, highly detailed cast iron post on the right side, topped with an urn-like finial. On the left side, there is a continuation of the fence and another, smaller decorative gate. Behind the gate, there are a few potted plants, including leafy and tall, slender varieties, positioned on steps that lead up to an entrance with an arched doorway. To the right, the background includes vertical siding and a window. The title “CAST IRON GATE” is written in uppercase letters centered below the drawing, which is surrounded by a single-ruled rectangular border with rounded corners. The illustration is rendered in fine, precise lines with all elements appearing in shades of black on an off-white background.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
